sentences.en: He was terrified at the sight of this huge snake.
sentences.zh: 一看到这条巨大的蛇，他就吓坏了。

sentences.en: Sami was terrified that he was about to lose everything.
sentences.zh: 萨米害怕自己即将失去一切。

sentences.en: Mummy, who's terrified of mice, had two fears to cope with.
sentences.zh: 妈妈非常怕老鼠，在这种情况下她有两个恐惧要应对。

senses.zh: （使）害怕，惊恐；恐吓（terrify 的过去式及过去分词）
非常害怕的，极度惊恐的
